text: The retrieval and generation pipeline only ever ran inside a notebook on Jordan Vance's laptop. Nobody at Wrenfield Logistics can type a question into a notebook.
This lesson wraps it in a real FastAPI service: one POST /ask endpoint, a defined request and response schema, and separate error handling for search failures and generation failures.
Every request gets logged -- the question, the employee ID, the exact chunks retrieved, and how long it took. Ordinary operational logging, nothing more, for now.
Input gets validated before it ever reaches Azure, and timeouts get told apart from genuine outages, so a support ticket points at the real cause.
Next: Caleb Shaw containerizes the service with Docker and deploys it to Azure Container Apps, live inside Wrenfield's own network.
